capabilities: Run initiative order as a plain-text code block or sidebar view
Read monster AC, HP and initiative from statblocks and frontmatter
Apply damage, healing, conditions and death saves, writing back to character sheets
Run large battles as group rows and several fights at once
Sync fights with an Atlas VTT map and a player-facing second screen
extras: Companion plugins are recommended but none is required; without them stats must be typed by hand. The README points to a YouTube tutorial and says "The full guide covers everything else" (docs elsewhere). Includes a developer API (ri.getState, ri.newCombat, dice hook, events) and an unofficial fan-project disclaimer for D&D and Cyberpunk RED trademarks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run combat, so game masters must track initiative, HP and conditions outside their vault or by hand.

relations.evidence: Roll for Initiative is built on Quick Initiative by walkertbrown (Bananafest Destiny).
Initiative Tracker Plus by Mike (msweat254), a community fork of Initiative Tracker, inspired
Fantasy Statblocks by Jeremy Valentine renders the statblock pane and supplies the bestiary.
Show the fight to your players on a second screen with TTRPG Tools – Player Screen
One DnD Character Sheet and Cyberpunk RED Character Sheet are companion plugins by the same author
It works with the Cyberpunk RED Character Sheet plugin.
Atlas VTT by Fabian Urbanek is the battle-map plugin the live sync talks to.
Fantasy Statblocks actions (through the Dice Roller plugin).

summary: Initiative tracker that runs D&D 5e and Cyberpunk RED combat as a plain-text code block in your notes, with statblock lookup and live character-sheet sync.
